findings.note: The entry is using v = half at, that is carrying the half from s = ut + half at squared into the velocity relation. That is a wrong belief about which formula gives the speed, not a number or algebra slip inside a right route, and the sidecar already types the twin entry mistakes[0] ('v = 2at') as concept. Typing it calculation also strips it of a route, so a student who used the wrong velocity formula this way has nothing to tap.
findings.fix: concept, with route 'I took v as half of at'

findings.quote: I found u and a from both seconds
findings.note: Every listed mistake starts from exactly this step - all three need a = 4 (and mistakes[1] needs u as well) before their slip - so the phrase does not separate the right solver from the wrong ones. What separates is using v = u + at at the asked time.
findings.fix: I used v = u + at at four seconds
